atoms.b: Renewable energy, such as ((++wind cloud)) power, is considered sustainable because it doesn’t use up the Earth’s natural ((++resources sauces)).
Resources like petrol and other fossil fuels ((++are_not are)) sustainable because they run out — and damage the planet in the process!
In our everyday lives, we can also be sustainable by reducing ((++plastic fantastic)) waste. We can choose to use products made of biodegradable materials, such as paper, instead.

hint.text: If something is biodegradable, it will break down naturally over time.
hint.label: Biodegradable

instruction.text: Look at the images and select the more sustainable product.

feedback.finish: The metal bottle is not biodegradable, but it is reusable, which also cuts down on the amount of single-use plastics.

instruction.text: Why is it important to practise sustainability? Decide whether the following statements are true or false.

atoms.a: Being sustainable helps to reduce pollution.
Being sustainable preserves animals’ natural habitats.
Being sustainable only helps us right now.

feedback.finish: Practising sustainability reduces plastic waste and the use of fossil fuels. This doesn’t just have a positive effect on the environment in the short term, but will also help protect the planet for the future.
